name: Recanati (Italy)
description: Red field with a yellow Greek cross throughout, a yellow lion rampant holding a sword in each quarter (the arms of Recanati).
history: Municipal flag of Recanati, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: lion rampant holding a sword in each quarter
